cases.comparison: Compare candidate and reference status for namespace lists, positive and negative patterns, signing-time validity boundaries, duplicate and unknown options, raw-key CA refusal, UTC/local zones, and a later valid entry.
cases.oracle: System Git 2.47.3 and OpenSSH check system-signed commit and tag objects against independently constructed allowed-signers entries.
cases.script:
export TZ=UTC0 GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
read -r kt kk comment < "$HOME/key.pub"
check() {
  local label=$1 opt=$2 command=${3:-verify-commit} object=${4:-HEAD} rc
  if [[ -n $opt ]]; then printf 'fixture@example.test %s %s %s\n' "$opt" "$kt" "$kk" > "$HOME/allowed"; else printf 'fixture@example.test %s %s\n' "$kt" "$kk" > "$HOME/allowed"; fi
  git -C signed -c gpg.format=ssh -c gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile="$HOME/allowed" "$command" "$object" >"$HOME/$label.out" 2>"$HOME/$label.err"; rc=$?
  printf '[%s] status=%s\n' "$label" "$rc" >>"$HOME/verification.log"
  /usr/bin/cat "$HOME/$label.out" "$HOME/$label.err" >>"$HOME/verification.log"
  if [[ $rc == 0 ]]; then printf '%s=accepted\n' "$label"; else printf '%s=rejected\n' "$label"; fi
}
check bare ''
check exact 'namespaces="git"'
check wildcard 'namespaces="g*"'
check question 'namespaces="gi?"'
check list 'namespaces="file,git"'
check negated 'namespaces="*,!g?t"'
check missing 'namespaces="file"'
check brackets 'namespaces="[g]it"'
check case 'NaMeSpAcEs="git"'
check window 'valid-after="20190101Z",namespaces="git",valid-before="20210101Z"'
check utc-suffix 'valid-after="20190101UTC",valid-before="20210101utc"'
check equal-after 'valid-after="20200301000000Z"'
check after 'valid-after="20200301000001Z"'
check equal-before 'valid-before="20200301000000Z"'
check before 'valid-before="20200229235959Z"'
check future 'valid-after="29990101Z"'
check backwards 'valid-before="20200301000000Z",valid-after="20200301000000Z"'
check duplicate 'namespaces="git",namespaces="git"'
check unknown 'namespaces="git",unknown="x"'
check ca 'cert-authority'
check noquote 'namespaces=git'
check tag 'valid-after="20190101Z",valid-before="20210101Z"' verify-tag signed-tag
export TZ=EST5
check local-boundary 'valid-after="20200229190000",valid-before="20200229190001"'
export TZ=UTC0
printf 'fixture@example.test namespaces="file" %s %s\nfixture@example.test namespaces="g*" %s %s\n' "$kt" "$kk" "$kt" "$kk" > "$HOME/allowed"
git -C signed -c gpg.format=ssh -c gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile="$HOME/allowed" verify-commit HEAD >"$HOME/multiline.out" 2>"$HOME/multiline.err"; rc=$?
printf '[multiline] status=%s\n' "$rc" >>"$HOME/verification.log"
/usr/bin/cat "$HOME/multiline.out" "$HOME/multiline.err" >>"$HOME/verification.log"
if [[ $rc == 0 ]]; then echo 'multiline=accepted'; else echo 'multiline=rejected'; fi
/usr/bin/rm -rf signed

cases.comparison: Show signature for default, custom and oneline log and custom show; respect --no-show-signature; do not report a tampered object as trusted and keep unsigned output unchanged.
cases.oracle: Reference Git and OpenSSH verify an independently signed commit; the bad object preserves its signature but alters its signed message.
cases.script:
export TZ=UTC0 GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.test GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.test
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2020-03-01T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2020-03-01T00:00:00Z'
read -r kt kk comment < "$HOME/key.pub"
printf 'fixture@example.test namespaces="git" %s %s\n' "$kt" "$kk" > "$HOME/allowed"
id=$(/usr/bin/git -C signed rev-parse HEAD)
runlog() { local label=$1; shift; git -C signed -c gpg.format=ssh -c gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile="$HOME/allowed" "$@" >"$HOME/$label.out" 2>"$HOME/$label.err"; }
runlog custom log -1 --show-signature --format=%H HEAD
out=$(<"$HOME/custom.out")
if [[ $out == *'Good "git" signature for fixture@example.test'*"$id"* ]]; then echo 'custom=signature-before-hash'; else echo 'custom=missing-or-wrong-order'; fi
runlog pretty log -1 --show-signature --pretty=format:%H HEAD
if /usr/bin/grep -F 'Good "git" signature for fixture@example.test' "$HOME/pretty.out" >/dev/null; then echo 'pretty=signature'; else echo 'pretty=missing'; fi
runlog default log -1 --show-signature HEAD
if /usr/bin/grep -F 'Good "git" signature for fixture@example.test' "$HOME/default.out" >/dev/null; then echo 'default=signature'; else echo 'default=missing'; fi
runlog oneline log -1 --show-signature --oneline HEAD
if /usr/bin/grep -F 'Good "git" signature for fixture@example.test' "$HOME/oneline.out" >/dev/null; then echo 'oneline=signature'; else echo 'oneline=missing'; fi
runlog show show -s --show-signature --format=%H HEAD
if /usr/bin/grep -F 'Good "git" signature for fixture@example.test' "$HOME/show.out" >/dev/null; then echo 'show=signature'; else echo 'show=missing'; fi
runlog disabled log -1 --show-signature --no-show-signature --format=%H HEAD
if [[ $(<"$HOME/disabled.out") == "$id" ]]; then echo 'disabled=hash-only'; else echo 'disabled=unexpected'; fi
/usr/bin/git -C signed cat-file commit HEAD > "$HOME/commit"
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; p=sys.argv[1]; d=open(p,"rb").read(); assert b"\n\nsigned\n" in d; open(p+".bad","wb").write(d.replace(b"\n\nsigned\n",b"\n\nchanged\n",1))' "$HOME/commit"
bad=$(/usr/bin/git -C signed hash-object -t commit -w --literally "$HOME/commit.bad")
runlog bad log -1 --show-signature --format=%H "$bad"
if /usr/bin/grep -F 'Good "git" signature for fixture@example.test' "$HOME/bad.out" >/dev/null; then echo 'bad=trusted'; else echo 'bad=not-trusted'; fi
/usr/bin/git -C signed commit --allow-empty -qm unsigned
unsigned=$(/usr/bin/git -C signed rev-parse HEAD)
runlog unsigned log -1 --show-signature --format=%H HEAD
if [[ $(<"$HOME/unsigned.out") == "$unsigned" ]]; then echo 'unsigned=hash-only'; else echo 'unsigned=unexpected'; fi
/usr/bin/rm -rf signed

cases.comparison: Local receiver must execute the hook, return rejection and preserve the server ref; the marker distinguishes execution from a simulated refusal.
cases.oracle: System Git creates and updates a fixture-only bare repository, then a pre-receive hook refuses a later update; compare with Git 2.47.3 client.
cases.script:
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.test GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.test
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2020-01-02T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2020-01-02T00:00:00Z'
git -C local push -q ../remote main >"$HOME/quiet-success.out" 2>"$HOME/quiet-success.err"; rc=$?
if [[ $rc == 0 && ! -s $HOME/quiet-success.out && ! -s $HOME/quiet-success.err ]]; then echo 'quiet-success=yes'; else echo 'quiet-success=no'; fi
before=$(/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse refs/heads/main)
printf 'second\n' >>local/file
/usr/bin/git -C local commit -qam second
printf '#!/bin/sh\n/usr/bin/touch "$HOME/local-hook-ran"\necho rejected-by-hook >&2\nexit 1\n' >remote/hooks/pre-receive
/usr/bin/chmod 755 remote/hooks/pre-receive
git -C local push -q ../remote main >"$HOME/quiet-rejected.out" 2>"$HOME/quiet-rejected.err"; rc=$?
after=$(/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse refs/heads/main)
printf 'status=%s\nbefore=%s\nafter=%s\n' "$rc" "$before" "$after" >"$HOME/local-observation.txt"
if [[ $rc == 1 && $after == "$before" ]] && /usr/bin/grep -F 'remote rejected' "$HOME/quiet-rejected.err" >/dev/null; then echo 'quiet-rejection=yes'; else echo 'quiet-rejection=no'; fi
if [[ -e $HOME/local-hook-ran ]]; then echo 'hook-ran=yes'; else echo 'hook-ran=no'; fi
/usr/bin/rm -rf remote local

export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=gc.auto GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=0 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=maintenance.auto GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=false
